assessments.name: Quizzes
assessments.description: Four 30min online quizzes completed after lectures in Weeks 1 through to Week 6 to be done outside class time.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task
assessments.description: Early Feedback Task Online Quiz based on material from Weeks 1, 2 and 3

assessments.name: Personal Statement
assessments.description: Written personal statement to be submitted online; an opportunity to formulate initial thinking on three core principles within your role as an educator: principles of inclusion, inclusive educational practices, and behaviour support.

assessments.name: Group Presentation Q&A
assessments.description: Q&A following group presentation based on scenario; each student in the group will be asked a question based on the group presentation; question to be answered in class verbally or in writing; attendance in class is required.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Group Presentation
assessments.description: Group presentation developed during tutorials to provide a response to a assigned scenario.

assessments.name: Fieldwork Placement
assessments.description: Self organised fieldwork placement to observe and submission of evidence; evidence of placement secured required by end Week 6
assessments.type: Peer or expert observation or supervision

assessments.name: Fieldwork Report
assessments.description: Written report based on fieldwork hours submitted online; report comprises a reflective journal and review of the literature on a topic related to your observations.
